title: Development charges hearing adjourned to February
subtitle: Short meeting; no other decisions. Staff offered alternative recommendations had the adjournment not been supported.
overview: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee met briefly and dealt with one item: a request to postpone a hearing on development charges complaints for two properties, 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road.

The committee recommended granting the adjournment until no later than February 9, 2026 {{vote:m1}}. The request came from the appellants, who asked for more time to consider their complaints. Staff supported the postponement.

Staff also noted they had prepared alternative recommendations in two other reports, FIN-2026-016 and FIN-2026-017, which would have applied had the committee declined the adjournment. For residents, the practical effect is that the complaints are not decided yet and will return to the committee at a later date. As a committee decision, this is a recommendation that Council must still adopt.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended granting the appellants' request to adjourn the hearing on the development charges complaints for 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road until no later than February 9, 2026.
